scenes.title: Basic, Pro and Enterprise
scenes.subtitle: One yearly price per agency, with room to grow
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro has three plans. You pay one yearly price for the whole agency, with users, allowances and packs on top when you need them.

scenes.heading: What each plan includes

rows.label: Leads, contacts, quotes, invoices, fleet, visas
AI lead capture, scoring, document scan

scenes.narration: Every plan has the full CRM, the shared inbox and the assistant, and calling where it is offered. Pro adds the AI tools, business intelligence, WhatsApp campaigns and your own website domain. Enterprise adds the website chat widget, more users and bigger allowances.

scenes.subtitle: Basic 5 users · Pro 10 users · Enterprise 25 users
scenes.narration: In India the plans are fourteen thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine, twenty-nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine, and seventy-four thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine rupees a year, with five, ten and twenty-five users. Agencies that join before April 2027 pay a founder price twenty percent lower. Other countries are billed in their own currency.
Skyline Holidays is on Basic. Open WhatsApp campaigns or the website chat and you get a clear upgrade prompt, never an error.
Basic in India includes five users. Invite a sixth, and the app offers an upgrade or an extra user instead.

The billing page shows the plan, the renewal date and how many users are in use. Allowances cover AI credits, WhatsApp templates, email, login codes and call minutes each month; when one runs out, buy a pack or upgrade.
Paying online opens the payment page; here it is the test gateway. Once paid, the subscription invoice appears in the agency's currency.

scenes.title: Thames & Tide Travel, Bristol
scenes.subtitle: Pro, billed in pounds
scenes.narration: Now a Pro agency in the UK.
On Pro, WhatsApp campaigns are open, and because the agency is in the UK, calling is available too. The website chat widget still asks for Enterprise.

scenes.title: Desert Pearl Tours, Dubai
scenes.subtitle: Enterprise, billed in US dollars
scenes.narration: And an Enterprise agency in Dubai.
Enterprise opens everything, including the website chat. Calling is not offered in the Gulf, so it does not appear here.

scenes.headline: Start small. Grow into it.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Start small, and grow into it.
